description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to the AR9 chipset, including hardware initialization, firmware management, and register configurations.

methods.name: ar9_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor) for the AR9 chipset.

methods.name: ar9_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware components and prepares the AR9 ATM driver.

methods.name: ar9_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the AR9 ATM hardware components.

methods.name: ar9_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware execution on the AR9 chipset by downloading firmware code.

methods.name: ar9_stop
methods.description: Stops firmware execution on the AR9 chipset.
